# Large media WebView test

Add the test dictionary (`desktop-large-media.dsl`) to wuDict2, then put these files in the adjacent `desktop-large-media.dsl.files` folder:

- `large-image.jpg` — an image larger than 8 MiB.
- `large-video.mp4` — a video larger than 8 MiB. Try playback and seeking.

The DSL article references both files. The media folder is next to the `.dsl` file so wuDict2 can resolve them as dictionary resources.
